title: Classification of quaternionic skew-Hermitian symmetric spaces
summary: We provide a complete classification of quaternionic skew-Hermitian symmetric spaces, namely symmetric spaces that admit a torsion-free ${\rm SO}^{*}(2n){\rm Sp}(1)$-structure for arbitrary $n>1$. Moreover, we prove that any homogeneous quaternionic skew-Hermitian manifold is necessarily a symmetric space.
